essay.title: SECTION B & C - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer all questions in Sections B and C. Write your answers clearly and show all necessary workings.

questions.question:
SECTION B - QUESTION 1
The following balances have been extracted from the books of Alban-Kudi for the year 2004:

Opening balances:
Purchases ledger balances ₦59,370
Sales ledger balances ₦98,720

Transactions for the year:
Purchases journal ₦773,125
Sales journal ₦998,310
Purchases returns ₦13,240
Sales returns ₦22,780
Cheques paid to suppliers ₦730,500
Cheques received from customers ₦929,800
Discount allowed ₦29,150
Discount received ₦10,670
Bad debts written off ₦1,980
Dishonoured cheque ₦150
Set-off ₦5,180
Petty cash paid to supplier ₦390

Closing balances at 31/12/2004:
Purchases ledger ₦72,650
Sales ledger ₦108,290

You are required to prepare:
(i) Sales Ledger Control Account
(ii) Purchases Ledger Control Account.

SECTION B - QUESTION 2
The following information was extracted from the books of Okere Manufacturing Company for the year ended 31st December, 2016:

Opening stock:
Raw materials ₦61,450
Finished goods ₦84,650
Work-in-progress ₦3,140

Wages ₦14,150
Carriage inwards of raw materials ₦650
Purchases of raw materials ₦42,360
Royalties ₦1,040
Plant and machinery: Cost ₦50,000; Book value ₦40,000
Factory expenses ₦11,430
Factory power ₦6,050
Rent ₦2,400
Insurance ₦3,000
Discount allowed ₦1,430
Carriage outwards ₦610
Sales ₦292,400
Salesmen salaries ₦41,200
Office stationery ₦4,300

Additional information:
(i) Closing stock at 31/12/2016:
Raw materials ₦30,420
Finished goods ₦7,200
Work-in-progress ₦1,680
(ii) Rent paid in advance ₦550
(iii) Insurance outstanding ₦600
(iv) Office stationery accrued ₦700
(v) Depreciation on plant and machinery at 10% per annum on cost.

You are required to prepare a Manufacturing, Trading, Profit and Loss Account for the year ended 31st December, 2016.

SECTION C - QUESTION 3
Explain the following:
(a) Prime cost
(b) Work-in-progress
(c) Manufacturing profit
(d) Finished goods
(e) Direct materials.

SECTION C - QUESTION 4
(a) What is depreciation?
(b) List three causes of depreciation.
(c) List three factors to be considered in the computation of depreciation.
(d) State the formula for calculating depreciation using:
(i) Straight-line method
(ii) Diminishing balance method.
